conditions: Incorrect booking details
Wrong dates/destination
required_actions: Correct error at no cost if TravelNova fault
Apply change fee if customer error
prohibited_actions: Do not promise free correction without verifying fault

conditions: Payment processed but no confirmation received
required_actions: If duplicate payment found, initiate refund
prohibited_actions: Do not ask customer to rebook and pay again before checking

conditions: Customer wants to change dates, passengers, or details
prohibited_actions: Do not waive fees without supervisor approval

conditions: Customer denied service due to overbooking by supplier
prohibited_actions: Do not blame customer
Do not offer upgrade as standard right

conditions: System created duplicate reservation
prohibited_actions: Do not ask customer to wait for standard refund timeline for obvious system errors

conditions: Flight delayed between 1 and 3 hours
prohibited_actions: Do not promise hotel accommodation for short delays

conditions: Flight delayed between 3 and 6 hours
prohibited_actions: Do not guarantee specific departure time

conditions: Flight delayed more than 6 hours
prohibited_actions: Do not deny accommodation for delays over 6 hours

conditions: Flight cancelled by airline
required_actions: Offer full refund within 7 days OR rebooking on next available
prohibited_actions: Do not force rebooking if customer wants refund

conditions: Customer missed connecting flight due to delay on first leg
required_actions: Rebook on next connection at no cost
prohibited_actions: Do not charge rebooking fees for airline-caused missed connections

conditions: Customer denied boarding due to overbooking
prohibited_actions: Do not minimize customer's experience

conditions: Seat not matching booking or family separated
required_actions: If pre-paid seat changed: refund seat selection fee
prohibited_actions: Do not promise specific seats

conditions: Room does not match advertised category or photos
required_actions: Offer relocation or partial refund (up to 30% per night)
prohibited_actions: Do not offer full refund without investigation

conditions: Confirmed reservation not honored by hotel
required_actions: Relocate to equal or higher category
prohibited_actions: Do not downgrade customer without consent and compensation

conditions: Unsanitary room conditions reported
required_actions: Contact hotel for immediate room change
If not resolved: relocate to alternative hotel
prohibited_actions: Do not dismiss cleanliness complaints

conditions: Safety hazard reported at hotel (fire safety, structural, security)
prohibited_actions: Do not delay action on safety concerns
Do not suggest customer wait

conditions: Early check-in denied, late check-out denied, long wait times
required_actions: Refund early check-in fee if paid and denied
If wait exceeds 2 hours: offer meal voucher
prohibited_actions: Do not promise late check-out

conditions: Advertised amenities not available (pool, WiFi, gym, breakfast)
required_actions: If confirmed missing: partial refund or credit
prohibited_actions: Do not dismiss as minor if customer booked specifically for amenity

conditions: Customer charged twice for same booking
prohibited_actions: Do not deny without checking payment records

conditions: Amount charged differs from quoted price
required_actions: Compare charged amount with booking record
If overcharge confirmed: refund difference within 3 days
Explain any legitimate additional charges (taxes, fees)
prohibited_actions: Do not dismiss price discrepancy without investigation

conditions: Customer disputes currency conversion rate or fee
required_actions: If fee not disclosed at booking: consider waiver
prohibited_actions: Do not promise refund of conversion fees without policy check

conditions: Customer did not authorize the charge
prohibited_actions: Do not delay freezing account
Do not share transaction details without identity verification

conditions: Missed installment, incorrect installment amount, payment plan dispute
required_actions: If system error: waive late fee and correct
prohibited_actions: Do not cancel booking for first missed payment without notice

conditions: Customer needs invoice or receipt
required_actions: Generate and send invoice within 24 hours

conditions: Customer hasn't received approved refund within stated timeline
required_actions: If processed: provide transaction reference for bank
If not processed: escalate internally and expedite
prohibited_actions: Do not tell customer to just wait without checking

conditions: Customer disagrees with refund amount
required_actions: If policy correctly applied: explain applicable deductions
prohibited_actions: Do not offer additional refund without policy basis

conditions: Refund request denied per policy, customer contests
required_actions: Explain denial reason with policy reference
Offer travel credit as alternative if applicable
prohibited_actions: Do not override refund denial without manager approval
Do not promise refund to appease angry customer

conditions: Refund request due to natural disaster, travel ban, pandemic
prohibited_actions: Do not deny force majeure refund without manager consultation

conditions: Customer claims cancellation was within free window but was charged
required_actions: Verify cancellation timestamp vs booking timestamp
If within 24hr window and >7 days before departure: process full refund
If system error: escalate to Tech
prohibited_actions: Do not deny without timestamp verification

conditions: Customer disputes the cancellation fee charged
prohibited_actions: Do not waive fees without documented justification

conditions: Airline/hotel/operator cancelled the service
required_actions: Offer full refund or equivalent rebooking at no cost
If flight: rebook on next available
prohibited_actions: Do not charge customer for supplier-caused cancellation

conditions: Group booking (10+) cancellation request
prohibited_actions: Do not process group cancellation without manager review

conditions: Customer reports unprofessional or rude agent
prohibited_actions: Do not dismiss customer's experience
Do not share agent disciplinary details with customer

conditions: Customer alleges discrimination based on race, gender, religion, etc.
prohibited_actions: Do not minimize allegation
Do not make determinations without investigation

conditions: Customer waited excessively for support response
Agent provided incorrect information leading to customer loss
required_actions: If confirmed wrong: compensate customer for resulting loss
prohibited_actions: Do not deny responsibility if records show misinformation

conditions: Website crash, error page, slow loading
required_actions: Assist customer with alternative booking method

conditions: Payment failed, charged without booking, timeout during payment
required_actions: If charged without booking: process refund or create booking
prohibited_actions: Do not ask customer to pay again without checking existing charge

conditions: Mobile app crash during booking or use
Customer cannot access their account
required_actions: Unlock account or guide password reset
prohibited_actions: Do not unlock without identity verification

conditions: Unauthorized access to customer account
prohibited_actions: Do not delay account lockdown

conditions: Customer's luggage lost during travel
required_actions: Follow up with airline within 48 hours
If Premium Protection: issue $100 emergency credit
prohibited_actions: Do not promise airline will find luggage
Do not promise compensation amounts beyond policy

conditions: Customer's luggage damaged during travel
required_actions: Guide customer to file PIR at airport
prohibited_actions: Do not accept liability on behalf of airline

conditions: Unexpected excess baggage charges
required_actions: Verify baggage allowance for booking class
prohibited_actions: Do not reimburse without verifying TravelNova fault

conditions: TravelNova provided wrong visa requirements
required_actions: Verify information provided vs correct requirements
If TravelNova error: full refund + rebooking + $200 compensation
prohibited_actions: Do not blame customer for relying on TravelNova guidance

conditions: E-ticket or voucher not received
required_actions: If departure within 24 hours: escalate to urgent

conditions: Name on booking doesn't match passport
required_actions: Correct name if minor typo (free within 48hrs, $50 after)
If major change: treat as cancellation + rebooking
prohibited_actions: Do not promise free name changes beyond policy

conditions: Customer injured, threatened, or experienced unsafe conditions
prohibited_actions: Do not delay response
Do not question validity of safety concern initially

conditions: Any concern involving safety of a minor
required_actions: Contact local authorities if imminent danger
prohibited_actions: Do not delay
Do not dismiss
Do not handle at agent level

conditions: Customer reports fraudulent booking or identity theft
prohibited_actions: Do not release booking details without identity verification

conditions: Customer's personal data exposed or compromised
required_actions: Report to Chief Privacy Officer within 1 hour
prohibited_actions: Do not minimize breach
Do not delay notification

conditions: Customer requests deletion of personal data
prohibited_actions: Do not delete legally required records

conditions: Customer receiving marketing after opting out
required_actions: Apologize and confirm removal within 48 hours
prohibited_actions: Do not send further marketing

conditions: Points not credited after booking/travel
required_actions: Verify booking and point earning rules
Credit missing points within 5 business days

conditions: Customer's points expired and they dispute
required_actions: If expired per policy (24 months inactive): explain
If within 30 days of expiry: consider goodwill restoration with manager approval
prohibited_actions: Do not restore expired points without checking policy

conditions: Customer disputes tier level or downgrade
required_actions: Verify points balance and tier thresholds
prohibited_actions: Do not upgrade tier manually without verification

conditions: Unable to redeem points or redemption error
required_actions: Check points balance and minimum redemption (1000 pts)
If system error: escalate to Tech
prohibited_actions: Do not allow redemption below minimum threshold

conditions: Suspicious points accumulation or redemption
prohibited_actions: Do not release points during investigation

conditions: Booked tour guide did not appear
Multiple components of package fell below advertised standard
required_actions: If 3+ components: 20% package refund + travel credit
prohibited_actions: Do not dismiss multi-component complaints

conditions: Package itinerary changed after booking
required_actions: If major change: offer full refund option
prohibited_actions: Do not force altered itinerary without customer consent

conditions: Booked airport/hotel transfer driver did not arrive
Rental car not matching reservation or in poor condition
required_actions: Free upgrade to next category or $50 daily credit

conditions: Car rental company charges for damage customer denies
required_actions: Request damage documentation from rental company
Review customer's pre-rental photos if available
prohibited_actions: Do not accept or deny claim without investigation

conditions: Diamond or Platinum loyalty tier customer with any complaint
prohibited_actions: Do not route to general queue
Do not exceed compensation limits without approval

conditions: Customer stranded at airport or foreign location
prohibited_actions: Do not leave customer without communication
Do not delay beyond 4 hours

conditions: Customer requests refund on non-refundable fare/rate
required_actions: Offer travel credit as alternative (if applicable)
Check if Premium Protection covers 'Cancel for Any Reason'
prohibited_actions: Do not promise refund on non-refundable booking
Do not override without manager approval

conditions: Customer found lower price after booking
required_actions: Explain that once booked, price is locked
TravelNova does not offer price matching
Offer travel credit if significant difference and within 24hr window
prohibited_actions: Do not promise price adjustments after booking

conditions: Cancellation due to medical emergency
prohibited_actions: Do not deny without reviewing documentation

conditions: Customer threatens legal action or mentions lawyer
prohibited_actions: Do not argue
Do not admit fault
Do not make promises to prevent legal action

conditions: Excessive noise at hotel affecting customer's stay
required_actions: If ongoing construction: offer partial refund or relocation

conditions: Customer encounters fees not disclosed at booking
required_actions: Verify if fee was disclosed in booking terms
If not disclosed: refund the fee
If disclosed but unclear: improve disclosure and offer goodwill credit
prohibited_actions: Do not dismiss hidden fee complaint without investigation

conditions: Booked activity/excursion cancelled by operator
required_actions: If part of package: adjust package price

conditions: Port of call changed or skipped
required_actions: Explain cruise line's right to change
Refund excursion fees for missed port
Advocate for onboard credit from cruise line
prohibited_actions: Do not promise compensation beyond excursion refund without cruise line agreement

conditions: Customer received partial refund and disputes deductions
prohibited_actions: Do not offer additional refund without policy justification

conditions: Customer follows up on previously unresolved complaint
prohibited_actions: Do not restart process from scratch
Do not ask customer to re-explain

conditions: Booking made under incorrect passenger name
required_actions: If completely different person: cancellation + rebooking
prohibited_actions: Do not promise free correction after 48hr window

conditions: Issues with food, entertainment, seat comfort, crew behavior on flight
prohibited_actions: Do not promise airline-side compensation

conditions: Hotel charged customer directly for services that should be included
required_actions: Verify what was included in booking
Contact hotel to reverse incorrect charge
If hotel refuses: reimburse customer and dispute with hotel
prohibited_actions: Do not dismiss as hotel issue without investigation

conditions: Booked accessible room/service not provided
prohibited_actions: Do not treat as low priority
Do not suggest customer should have confirmed directly with hotel

conditions: Customer stuck in foreign country due to any reason
prohibited_actions: Do not leave without plan
Do not suggest customer arrange own travel home

conditions: Customer's data shared with third party without authorization
prohibited_actions: Do not minimize
Do not deny without investigation

conditions: TravelNova cancels booking due to supplier/safety/operational reasons
required_actions: Full refund or equivalent rebooking at no cost
Offer alternatives before cancellation when possible
prohibited_actions: Do not cancel without notifying customer
Do not charge fees for TravelNova-initiated cancellation

conditions: Payment failed but funds held on customer's card
required_actions: Explain hold release timeline (5-7 business days)
prohibited_actions: Do not promise to expedite bank hold release (TravelNova cannot control this)

conditions: Airline changed flight time after booking
required_actions: If change >2 hours: offer rebooking or refund
If minor change (<2 hours): inform only
prohibited_actions: Do not ignore schedule changes

conditions: Bugs, bedbugs, rodents, or other pests at hotel
required_actions: Report to health authorities if severe
Remove hotel from listings pending review
prohibited_actions: Do not offer room change in same hotel
Do not minimize health risk

conditions: Tour guide behaved inappropriately or unprofessionally
required_actions: If serious misconduct: escalate to Safety

conditions: Transfer driver arrived significantly late
required_actions: If caused missed flight/event: escalate and compensate fully

conditions: Refund requested for booking older than 12 months
prohibited_actions: Do not process refund for bookings >12 months without Compliance approval

conditions: Agent made a promise that was not fulfilled
required_actions: Honor the promise if documented and reasonable
If promise was unauthorized: explain and offer alternative resolution
prohibited_actions: Do not deny promise without checking records

conditions: Government travel advisory changed after booking
required_actions: Level 4: full refund or free rebooking
prohibited_actions: Do not force travel to Level 3+ destinations

conditions: Customer has medical emergency while traveling
required_actions: Arrange medical evacuation if Premium Protection
prohibited_actions: Do not delay medical assistance
Do not question the emergency

conditions: Points transfer to/from partner program failed
Hotel staff rude or unhelpful to TravelNova customer
Promotional discount or coupon not reflected in charge
required_actions: If valid: apply retroactively and refund difference
prohibited_actions: Do not honor expired promotions without manager approval

conditions: Customer experienced harassment at hotel, tour, or by partner service staff
required_actions: Report to local authorities if requested
prohibited_actions: Do not minimize
Do not question victim
Do not delay response

conditions: Confirmed booking disappeared from system
required_actions: If cannot recover: rebook at same or better terms at no cost
prohibited_actions: Do not ask customer to rebook and pay again

conditions: Customer claims no-show penalty is unjust
required_actions: If customer attempted contact before: consider waiver
If system error prevented check-in: waive penalty
prohibited_actions: Do not waive without verification

conditions: High-value booking dispute exceeding $10,000
required_actions: Manager review of all financial aspects
prohibited_actions: Do not resolve at agent level for amounts >$10,000

conditions: Complaint posted on social media by customer with significant following
prohibited_actions: Do not ignore
Do not argue publicly
Do not delete comments

conditions: Customer involuntarily downgraded from booked cabin class
required_actions: If TravelNova booked wrong class: full class upgrade or refund
prohibited_actions: Do not blame airline without checking TravelNova booking records

conditions: Customer wants cash refund instead of travel credit
required_actions: Explain that credits include 10% bonus value
If original terms allow cash: process cash refund
If policy mandates credit only: explain
prohibited_actions: Do not convert credit to cash without policy basis

conditions: Cruise cabin not as booked or in poor condition
required_actions: Contact cruise line for cabin change/upgrade
If onboard: must be reported immediately
prohibited_actions: Do not promise full cruise refund for cabin issues

conditions: Price shown in wrong currency on website leading to booking at unexpected price
required_actions: If confirmed bug: honor displayed price or offer full refund
prohibited_actions: Do not force customer to pay higher amount due to system error

conditions: Destination experiences terrorism or political instability after booking
required_actions: Evacuation assistance if customers already at destination
prohibited_actions: Do not minimize safety risks
Do not deny refund for active conflict zones

conditions: Complaint does not map to a specific travel category
required_actions: Identify the real category and re-route
prohibited_actions: Do not close a misrouted complaint without re-routing

conditions: Complaint spans more than one product line
required_actions: Split into primary and secondary issues
prohibited_actions: Do not reply before both departments have input
